name: kimi
description: Call local Kimi Code as a Codex subagent over ACP (multimodal, goals, resume).

interface.shortDescription: Local Kimi Code as a Codex subagent
interface.longDescription: Thin ACP bridge: hand tasks to local Kimi Code as a subagent (kimi_rescue). Kimi keeps its own tools, models, skills, and multimodal strengths. One handoff returns the subagent result; long work may continue via status/result if the MCP wait budget ends. Requires a local Kimi Code CLI (not Codex Cloud).
defaultPrompt: Hand this substantial frontend or multi-file task to the Kimi Code subagent.
Use kimi_rescue and return Kimi's result verbatim.
